scenario.task:
My phone service was suspended because I forgot to pay my bill, and I want to pay it and get restored

User Guide: Say 'My phone line is suspended and I need to restore it.' Authenticate. When told it's due to non-payment, pay the outstanding balance. Confirm that your service is being restored If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
